verses.text: Ix yalan Jehová t'ayin icha tik: Awajanh t'a chaanh, manh ach xiw awaji. Te chaanh tz'el aw icha spuji junok k'een trompeta. Al t'a heb' yinhtilal Jacob tik to te pit heb', te chuk heb'.

Junjun k'u skomon och heb' ejmelal t'ayin. Skomon tzalaj heb', snib'an heb' yojtakejel in b'eyb'al, icha junok chonhab'il anima sb'eyb'alan tojolal, ichato malaj b'aj syik'el spensar heb' t'a in cheknab'il, ichato sk'an juntzanh cheknab'il heb' yik tojolal t'ayin, sch'oxan heb' to stzalaj heb' sjawi t'ayin.

Ijan skot yowal heb' t'ayin syalan heb' icha tik: Nab'anhej tzonh komon och tzek'ojk'olal t'ayach, tokwal tzonh ila'. Nab'anhej skixtej ko b'a koch ejmelal t'ayach, tokwal tzonh a na'a, xchi heb'. Swalan icha tik: Yel toni, ayik tzex och t'a tzek'ojk'olal chi', anhej tas tze nib'ej, a chi' tze k'ulej, tzeyixtan heb' he munlajwum.
Ayik tzex komon och t'a tzek'ojk'olal chi', anhej telajb'ail yet' owal tzeyak'a', tze mak'lan he b'a yuj he chuk pensaril. Tokwal ol wab' he lesal t'a jun he tzek'ojk'olal tzeyak' chi'.

¿Tom a he naani to tzin tzalaj yet' tas tzeyutej he b'a chi'? Ha jun tze k'ulej chi' kusk'olal, tzex komon em nhojan icha spakchaj te' aj, tzex komon ek' jichan t'a yib'anh k'een tik'ak'il taanh yet' pichul ya swa'i. ¿Tom a jun chi' tzeyak' skuch tzek'ojk'olal te wach' t'a yol in sat he naani?

Palta manh ichok ta'. Ol wal t'ayex to a tzek'ojk'olal scha in k'ool, haton stzolal tik: Kolekelta heb' anima ayoch t'a yol sk'ab' heb' chuk spensar. Manhxo eyixtej heb' smunlaj t'ayex, aktejekel heb' tz'ixtaj chi', manhxo eyixtej heb'.

Ha heb' anima scham yuj wejel, ak'ek swael heb'. Haxo heb' malaj spat, ak'ek sposado heb' t'a he pat. Ha heb' malaj spichul, ak'ekoch spichul heb', manh eyaktej eyak'an sniwanil sk'ol heb' eyetchonhab'.

Tato icha chi' tzeyutej he b'a, yalnhej b'aj ol cheklaj in wach'k'olal t'ayex, icha tz'aj sk'inhib'i t'a junxo k'u. Elanhchamel ol ex kolchajok. Ha in he tojolal waji, b'ab'el in b'at eyuuj, haxo in tzikikial, tzak'an eyuuj.

Yuj chi' tato ol ex awaj t'ayin, elanhchamel ol in tak'wok t'ayex. Tato ol el eyaw he k'anan in kolwal, ol walan t'ayex icha tik: Ina in tik, xin chama. Tzeyik'el juntzanh chukal chi' t'a he kal. Manh he suy slumal heb' eyetanimail, manhxo he nak'e esal lolonel t'a spatik heb'.

Tato tzeyak' swael heb' ay swejel, tzex kolwaj t'a heb' ay tas tz'och yuj, tato icha chi', ol cheklaj he wach'il t'a skal anima icha sakil k'inal t'a skal k'ik' k'inal. Ol ex cheklajel icha yok k'u t'a chimk'ualil t'a skal k'ik' k'inal chi'.

Tato icha chi', ol ex in kuchb'ejnhej. Jantak he wael ol wak' t'a lum tzinan lu'um. Ol wak'an yip he niwanil, lajan ol ex aj icha junok tas awab'il aynhejoch yalil, ma icha junok sjaj ha ha' malaj b'ak'inh stupi.
Ol he b'oxik'e he chonhab' t'a yet'tal b'aj jub'ilemi, haton t'a yib'anh yich aykanem t'a peka'. Ol alchaj t'ayex to b'oumexxik'e muro lanhchajnak, b'oumexxik'e pat lanhchajnakemi.

Ha in Jehová in tik swala': Tato manh komonok tzeyutejb'at sk'ual ik'oj ip, malaj he munlajel tze b'o t'a jun k'u wik yaj chi', tato tzex tzalaj paxi yujnhej to ay yelk'och jun k'u chi' t'ayex, max eyal komon lolonel,

tato icha chi', ol ex tzalaj wet'ok. Ha in ol wak' sniwanil eyelk'och t'a masanil chonhab'. Ol eyak' tzalajb'ok he k'ool t'a lum lum wak'nak he makb'enok t'a he mam eyicham aj Jacob. Ha in ton Jehová in swalkan jun tik.
